column1: # S4b held-out list: domains not in S4's list, with ground truth from the providers' own help pages.
# Researched on 2026-10-04 by three agents that only read public help pages (plus one DoH MX lookup per
# custom-domain candidate, recorded in the evidence column); the lead did not see this list until the
# S4b rules were frozen (results/rules-freeze.txt). Frozen before any pipeline request to these domains.
# Columns: domain, group, expect (settings|unsupported|no-mail|unknown), imap, smtp, evidence.
# Endpoint: host:port:tls|starttls:users, users = addr | local | other | local/addr; ' ; ' separates endpoints.

column6: https://support.proisp.com/hc/nb/articles/10203805481617-Serverinformasjon-for-oppsett-av-e-post (read 2026-10-04 via the help centre's public API https://support.proisp.com/api/v2/help_center/nb/articles/10203805481617.json because the HTML page returns 403 to automated fetches; article updated 2023-03-07): user = full address; 993/465 SSL/TLS recommended, 143/587 with STARTTLS (or no encryption, not recorded) also allowed; the page says these hosts replace mail.<customer domain> and cpanelXX.proisp.no; PRO ISP is a Group.One Norway brand (2nd-largest .no registrar in Norid's top-10 list, data 2026-10-04)

https://support.uniweb.no/hc/nb/articles/5766119349905-Oppsett-av-e-post (read 2026-10-04 via the help centre's public API https://support.uniweb.no/api/v2/help_center/nb/articles/5766119349905.json because the HTML page returns 403 to automated fetches; article updated 2026-09-17): user = full address; 993 and 465 SSL/TLS recommended, 143 and 587 STARTTLS as fallbacks; Uniweb is the second Group.One Norway brand next to PRO ISP

https://www.webhuset.no/hjelp/email/serverinnstillinger-for-epost-komplett-referanse and https://www.webhuset.no/hjelp/email/oppsett-av-epost (read 2026-10-04): user = full address; reference page gives SMTP 465 SSL/TLS or 587 STARTTLS; the setup page also lists imap.webhuset.no:143 and smtp 587 as 'uten SSL' with no STARTTLS stated for 143 (143 not recorded); Webhuset is the 4th-largest .no registrar (Norid top-10, data 2026-10-04)

https://www.domene.no/klient/knowledgebase/1/Generell-informasjon-om-epost.html and https://www.domene.no/klient/index.php?rp=/knowledgebase/5/Servernavnet-eposttrafikk.html (read 2026-10-04): user = full address; docs give only the pattern mail.<your domain> for IMAP and SMTP, so mail.domene.no is derived from that pattern for the host's own domain; per-server names <server>.domene.no are shown only in the control panel; ports 143 and 587 are documented 'uten SSL' with no STARTTLS (not recorded); Domene AS is the 5th-largest .no registrar (Norid top-10, data 2026-10-04)

https://www.telia.se/support/appar-och-tjanster/guider/fragor-och-svar-om-telia-webmail (read 2026-10-04): Telia Sweden consumer mail (Telia Webmail); username form not documented; IMAP 993 'med SSL' and SMTP 465 'med SSL' with SMTP auth; IMAP 143 and SMTP 587 documented 'utan SSL' (not recorded); no new mailboxes since 2025-10-01, existing ones continue for customers with a Telia base service; Telia's pages do not name the address domain, @telia.com is stated by https://www.bredbandsval.se/bredband/webmail (third party, updated 2026-08-27)

https://www.bredbandsval.se/bredband/webmail (updated 2026-08-27, read 2026-10-04): Com Hem webmail 'nedlagd sedan januari 2021'; https://feber.se/internet/tele2-och-com-hems-mailtjanster-stangs-ner/419296/ (published 2020-12-14): Tele2 shutting down the Tele2 and Com Hem mail services; Tele2's own closure page https://www.comhem.se/kundservice/bredband/stanga-epost was unreachable on 2026-10-04 (connection refused or timed out); per the bredbandsval.se page the Com Hem brand was merged into Tele2 in April 2021

https://yousee.dk/hjaelp/artikler/hvad-er-mine-serveroplysninger-til-yousee-mail plus https://yousee.dk/hjaelp/artikler/opsaet-yousee-mail/ios , https://yousee.dk/hjaelp/artikler/opsaet-yousee-mail/android and https://yousee.dk/hjaelp/artikler/opdatering-af-din-mailopsaetning (read 2026-10-04): YouSee (TDC/Nuuday) Mail, the example address on the server page is @youmail.dk; user = full address; IMAP 993 with SSL; SMTP TLS labels are inconsistent: the server page labels both 587 and 465 'SSL (STARTTLS)', the Android guide uses TLS on 587, the iOS guide says 'Brug SSL' for 465 or 587 and the Outlook guide says SSL/TLS for 587 or 465; recorded 465 as tls and 587 as starttls

https://elisa.fi/asiakaspalvelu/palvelut/sahkopostin-asetukset/ (read 2026-10-04): Elisa mail; the page says the settings are the same for Elisa mail and the old Saunalahti mail (@saunalahti.fi); user = full address; unencrypted alternatives (IMAP 143, smtp.kolumbus.fi:25 without auth from Elisa networks only) not recorded; aliases mail.saunalahti.fi and smtpa.saunalahti.fi appear only in user posts on yhteiso.elisa.fi, not on the official page (not recorded)

column6: https://www.dna.fi/tuki/palvelut/webmail (read 2026-10-04): DNA Sahkoposti; mail.dnamail.fi and smtp.dnamail.fi marked as recommended; IMAP 993 SSL, SMTP 465 TLS and 587 STARTTLS, both with auth (port 25 unencrypted, not recorded); username form not documented (the page refers to a separate kayttajatunnus and says to contact customer service if it is forgotten); DNA's incident notice https://www.dna.fi/tuki/hairiotilanteet/hairiotiedotteet?scrollTo=yRw9P6n8aokQ&type=resttukari1&id=10612&status=all lists dnainternet, Welho, phnet and mail.suomi.net addresses as DNA consumer mail; no new mailboxes can be opened (service description 8/2024), existing ones continue

https://adstod.siminn.is/home/tolvupostur (page dated 2026-07-08, read 2026-10-04): Siminn mail, addresses use the domain simnet.is (up to five with each internet subscription); user = full address; IMAP 993 SSL/TLS, SMTP 587 STARTTLS; IMAP and POP can be switched on or off in the webmail settings (default not stated); mailbox terms https://static.siminn.is/web/terms/SKM-010928+Skilmalar+postholfathjonustu+-+samantekt.pdf cover @simnet.is

https://www.telekom.de/hilfe/apps-dienste/e-mail/posteingang-postausgang-server (read 2026-10-04): IMAP server secureimap.t-online.de, Port 993, 'Sicherheit: SSL'; SMTP server securesmtp.t-online.de, 'Port: 465 oder 587', 'Sicherheit: SSL' (one line for both ports; the page never says STARTTLS, 587 recorded as starttls by submission-port convention = ambiguity); same servers for @magenta.de. https://www.telekom.de/hilfe/apps-dienste/e-mail/app-programm-einrichten (read 2026-10-04): a mail program needs name, e-mail address, 'Passwort für E-Mail-Programme' and the servers; https://www.telekom.de/hilfe/apps-dienste/e-mail/smtp-relay-server (read 2026-10-04): mail programs use 'Ihre E-Mail-Adresse und das Passwort für E-Mail-Programme' -> user = full address (no explicit 'Benutzername' line on the server page). Separate e-mail-program password required (not the Telekom login password). securesmtprelay.t-online.de (25/465) is only in the paid Mail M package, so it is not listed.

https://assistance.orange.fr/ordinateurs-peripheriques/installer-et-utiliser/l-utilisation-du-mail-et-du-cloud/mail-orange/le-mail-orange-nouvelle-version/parametrer-la-boite-mail/mail-orange-comment-acceder-a-sa-boite-mail-orange-depuis-une-application-ou-un-logiciel-de-messagerie-non-fourni-par-orange_434630-964290 (read 2026-10-04): IMAP imap.orange.fr port 993 'Type de sécurité : OUI SSL/TLS'; SMTP smtp.orange.fr port 465 SSL/TLS with SMTP authentication; 'Identifiant (il s'agit de votre adresse mail @wanadoo.fr ou @orange.fr)' -> user = full address; a dedicated password for third-party mail software (from Espace client) is recommended; no 587/STARTTLS endpoint documented; same servers for @wanadoo.fr. https://assistance.orange.fr/ordinateurs-peripheriques/installer-et-utiliser/l-utilisation-du-mail-et-du-cloud/mail-orange/le-mail-orange-nouvelle-version/parametrer-la-boite-mail/mail-orange-comment-activer-ou-desactiver-les-acces-pop-imap-pour-les-logiciels-ou-applications-de-messagerie-tiers_427398-957069 (read 2026-10-04): POP/IMAP access is on by default and can be switched off in webmail settings.

https://www.bt.com/help/email/manage-email-account/manual-settings/what-are-the-settings-for-outgoing-and-incoming-bt-email-servers (read 2026-10-04): IMAP mail.btinternet.com port 993 'SSL Encryption: Enabled but not STARTTLS'; SMTP mail.btinternet.com port 465 'SSL Encryption: Enabled (but not STARTTLS)', Authentication PLAIN, SMTP auth required; 'Username: your email address including the @btinternet or @btopenworld.com part' -> user = full address; port 143 mentioned only as the non-secure setting to change (excluded); no 587 documented; same servers for @btopenworld.com.

https://www.swisscom.ch/de/privatkunden/hilfe/e-mail/einrichten.html (read 2026-10-04; .../einrichten/swisscom-server-information.html redirects here; EN https://www.swisscom.ch/en/residential/help/e-mail/setup.html and FR configurer.html say the same): 'Accounttyp: IMAP', 'Benutzername: E-Mail-Adresse', 'Serveradresse: imaps.bluewin.ch (Port 993) und smtpauths.bluewin.ch (Port 465)' -> user = full address; the page gives host and port only, no encryption wording (tls inferred from ports 993/465 = ambiguity); password is the separate E-Mail-Passwort, not the Swisscom Login; no 143/587 or STARTTLS endpoint documented.

https://www.kpn.com/service/ugs/instellen-e-mail-laptop-pc (read 2026-10-04; old URL https://www.kpn.com/service/internet/e-mail/instellen-laptop-pc.htm redirects there; the settings text is in the page's embedded data): 'Inkomende server: imap.kpnmail.nl (SSL aanvinken en poort 993 invullen)', 'Uitgaande server: smtp.kpnmail.nl (TLS aanvinken en poort 587 invullen)', 'Gebruikersnaam: KPN e-mailadres' -> user = full address; 587 is labelled only 'TLS' and is recorded as starttls (ambiguity); no 465 documented for kpnmail.nl (465 appears only for smtp.xs4all.nl). Same text in KPN's Kennisbank article by a KPN moderator https://community.kpn.com/kennisbank-e-mail-135/je-kpn-e-mail-instellen-in-een-mailprogramma-of-op-een-ander-apparaat-626771 (read 2026-10-04) and on https://www.kpn.com/service/ugs/geen-e-mail-ontvangen-of-versturen.

https://www.tim.it/assistenza/assistenza-tecnica/mail/configurazione/protocolli-posta (read 2026-10-04): for @tim.it 'Nome utente: inserire il proprio indirizzo di posta completo del dominio @tim.it'; IMAP imap.tim.it 'Porta di comunicazione IMAP: 143 (StartTLS)'; SMTP smtp.tim.it 'Porta di comunicazione SMTP: 587 (StartTLS)' -> user = full address; no 993/465 endpoint documented; page says clients without a StartTLS option (some Apple clients) should pick 'TLS'; TIM Mail boxes not tied to a TIM fixed or mobile line may use POP3/IMAP only over a TIM internet connection; legacy @alice.it uses in.alice.it:143 and out.alice.it:587, both StartTLS.

https://www.proximus.be/support/en/id_faq_mail_auth/customs/helpcenter-steps/faq-call/faq-mail-config/faq-call-faq-mail-config-faq-mail-auth.html (read 2026-10-04; FR version same): incoming 'Server: imap.proximus.be, Port: 993, Encryption method: SSL/TLS'; outgoing 'Server: relay.proximus.be, Port: 587, Encryption method: STARTTLS', SMTP auth required with the same settings as incoming; https://www.proximus.be/support/en/id_smartphone-email-messages/personal/support/smartphone-configuration/smartphone-email-messages.html (read 2026-10-04): 'Enter your full e-mail address and password' (domain skynet.be or proximus.be) -> user = full address. The full configuration page (id_sfaqr_mail_config) is an interactive JS flow that could not be read without running it, so no other endpoints were checked.

https://www.a1.net/faq/webmail/e-mail-sicherheit/e-mails-sicher-abrufen-faq and https://www.a1.net/faq/webmail/hilfe-fuer-e-mail-probleme/a1-sicherer-smtp-server-einrichten (read 2026-10-04): IMAP securemail.a1.net port 993 'Verbindungstyp SSL'; SMTP securemail.a1.net port 587 'Verbindungstyp STARTTLS'; SMTP auth to be enabled when sending from a foreign network; no 465 documented. https://www.a1.net/faq-assets/2025/05/A1-E-Mail-Einstellungen-Outlook-2019.pdf and https://www.a1.net/faq-assets/2025/02/A1-E-Mail-Einstellungen-New-Outlook.pdf (read 2026-10-04): 'Benutzername: Ihre E-Mail-Adresse' -> user = full address, BUT the examples are the provider-assigned mailbox address (a1.<Kundennummer>@a1.net or aon.<number>@aon.at), and the Outlook 2019 screenshot pairs a chosen alias address with a login of that mailbox form, so for alias addresses the login looks provider-assigned (other) = ambiguity; https://www.a1.net/faq/webmail/verwenden-von-webmail/a1-webmail-login-durchfuehren (read 2026-10-04): webmail accepts the mailbox address or the alias address.

https://i.ntnu.no/wiki/-/wiki/Norsk/Sett+opp+e-postkonto+i+Thunderbird and https://i.ntnu.no/wiki/-/wiki/English/Setup+email+account+in+Thunderbird (NTNU's own Thunderbird guide for students and staff, read 2026-10-04): IMAP outlook.office365.com 993 SSL/TLS OAuth2; SMTP smtp.office365.com 587 STARTTLS OAuth2; username brukernavn@ntnu.no, and the guide tells users to enter brukernavn@ntnu.no (NTNU account name + @ntnu.no) as the e-mail address too, hence addr; caveat: NTNU staff pages found by web search show first.last@ntnu.no addresses, which are not the documented login (would be other if the user types that address); platform Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online), matches https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/exchange/clients-and-mobile-in-exchange-online/pop3-and-imap4/pop3-and-imap4 (read 2026-10-04: IMAP4 outlook.office365.com 993 SSL/TLS, SMTP smtp.office365.com 587 STARTTLS); MX 10 mx.ntnu.no, NTNU's own gateway, does not reveal M365 (dns.google 2026-10-04T14:23:00Z); selection: first organization in a web search for M365 Thunderbird setup pages (Norwegian query)

https://gposta.unimore.it/parametri-di-gmail/ (UniMORE's official mail-service site, posted 2016-11-02, updated 2022-11-21, read 2026-10-04): IMAP imap.gmail.com 993 SSL/TLS OAuth; SMTP smtp.gmail.com 465 SSL/TLS OAuth; username = your complete e-mail address username@unimore.it, domain required, hence addr; https://gposta.unimore.it/ (read 2026-10-04): institutional mail is a Google Workspace domain, each account is username@unimore.it with an alias nome.cognome@unimore.it (the alias is not the documented login; would be other if the user types the alias); 587 STARTTLS: listed by the department wiki https://web.ing.unimo.it/wiki/index.php/Note_sulla_posta_elettronica_di_UniMORE (read 2026-10-04, SMTP SSL 465 and TLS/STARTTLS 587; its Outlook section also shows imap.gmail.com port 995, evidently a typo for 993, not recorded) and by Google Workspace admin help https://support.google.com/a/answer/176600 (redirects to knowledge.workspace.google.com/admin/gmail/send-email-from-a-printer-scanner-or-app, read 2026-10-04: smtp.gmail.com SSL 465 or TLS 587, complete Workspace address); platform Google Workspace; MX aspmx.l.google.com and alt1-alt4.aspmx.l.google.com (dns.google 2026-10-04T14:23:00Z); selection: first Google Workspace organization in a web search restricted to European TLDs

https://www.lu.se/student/it-tjanster-och-studentsupport/studentmejl (Lund University student mail page, updated 2026-09-16, read 2026-10-04): student mail is Google Workspace; IMAP imap.gmail.com 993 SSL; SMTP smtp.gmail.com 465 SSL; username = student account ID + @student.lu.se (format ab1234cd-s@student.lu.se), while the page gives the student address as fornamn.efternamn.NNNN@student.lu.se, hence other; the page says both addresses reach the same inbox, so addr works only if the user enters the account-ID address; smtp.gmail.com 587 is not on the LU page, taken from Google Workspace admin help https://support.google.com/a/answer/176600 (read 2026-10-04: SSL 465 or TLS 587); MX aspmx.l.google.com, alt1/alt2.aspmx.l.google.com, aspmx2-aspmx5.googlemail.com (dns.google 2026-10-04T14:23:00Z); selection: first result of a Nordic-TLD web search for university mail-client settings

http://kaersholm.com/Mail%20opsaetning.pdf (Kaersholm local community site of Foreningen Kaersholm / Kaersholm Vandvaerk, PDF created 2014-05-30, read 2026-10-04): IMAP imap.one.com 993 SSL; SMTP send.one.com 465 SSL with authentication; username not stated; the PDF is not linked from the current site pages; host one.com: https://help.one.com/hc/en-us/articles/115005594285-How-to-set-an-email-account-in-for-example-Outlook (HTML returned 403 to curl, read 2026-10-04 via the public help-center API https://help.one.com/api/v2/help_center/en-us/articles/115005594285.json, article updated 2026-10-03): username = full email address; IMAP imap.one.com 993 SSL; SMTP send.one.com 587 TLS/SSL/STARTTLS or 465 SSL/TLS; MX mx1-mx4.pub.mailpod14-cph3.one.com (dns.google 2026-10-04T14:23:01Z); selection: first organization result of a Danish web search for imap.one.com setup pages

https://redder.dk/mailopsaetning/ (Reddernes Landsklub, read 2026-10-04): username = full mail address; iPhone/iPad section: incoming mail.simply.com, outgoing smtp.simply.com, no ports or TLS given; its Outlook section still names legacy hosts mail.unoeuro.com and astmp.unoeuro.com [sic] with SMTP port 587 (or 25) and no TLS mode, not recorded as endpoints; host Simply.com (all read 2026-10-04): https://www.simply.com/en/support/faq/mail/115-setting-up-email/ (IMAP 143 TLS/STARTTLS, SMTP 587 TLS/STARTTLS, username = full address), https://www.simply.com/en/support/faq/mail/831-setting-up-mail-in-outlook-new/ (IMAP 993 SSL/TLS, SMTP 587 StartTLS), https://www.simply.com/en/support/faq/mail/757-setting-up-mail-in-outlook-for-microsoft-365/ (IMAP 143 STARTTLS or 993, SMTP 587 STARTTLS), https://www.simply.com/en/support/faq/mail/362-setting-up-email-in-outlook-app-android/ (smtp.simply.com:465 with no mode stated; recorded as implicit TLS by port convention); MX mx.simply.com (dns.google 2026-10-04T14:23:01Z); selection: first result of a web search for Simply.com/UnoEuro mail setup pages of organizations

https://www.esam-c2.fr/IMG/pdf/mails-configuration-esam.pdf (ESAM Caen/Cherbourg art school's own Infomaniak mail sheet, PDF dated 2022-09-20, read 2026-10-04): IMAP mail.infomaniak.com 993 SSL; SMTP mail.infomaniak.com 465 SSL/TLS; username = full address; host Infomaniak (read 2026-10-04): https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2427/sync-your-emails-across-all-your-devices (IMAP 993 SSL; SMTP 587 STARTTLS preferred, 465 SSL/TLS as alternative; username = full address) and https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/468/understanding-mail-server-ports-and-protocols (same table, plus 'other supported ports' 143 and 25 with STARTTLS for backward compatibility; the 143 and 25 endpoints come only from that note, 993/587 are recommended); MX 5 mta-gw.infomaniak.ch (dns.google 2026-10-04T14:23:01Z); selection: first result of a web search for Infomaniak mail-configuration pages of associations

https://www.civam.org/wp-content/uploads/2020/12/Messagerie_Process_Thunderbird.pdf (Reseau Civam's own Thunderbird guide, PDF dated 2020-04-20, written for the move of Civam mailboxes from Globenet to OVH, read 2026-10-04): IMAP ssl0.ovh.net 993 SSL/TLS normal password; SMTP ssl0.ovh.net 465 SSL/TLS; address field = full e-mail address, username not stated separately; host OVHcloud MX Plan (read 2026-10-04): https://docs.ovhcloud.com/en/guides/web-cloud/email-and-collaborative-solutions/mx-plan/email-generalities (updated 2026-07-07: username = full address; IMAP imap.mail.ovh.net or ssl0.ovh.net 993 SSL/TLS; SMTP smtp.mail.ovh.net or ssl0.ovh.net 465 SSL/TLS) and https://help.ovhcloud.com/csm/en-mx-plan-thunderbird-windows-configuration?id=kb_article_view&sysparm_article=KB0052136 (SMTP 587 STARTTLS on the same hosts); imap.mail.ovh.net and smtp.mail.ovh.net come only from OVH's pages; MX 1 mx1.mail.ovh.net, 5 mx2.mail.ovh.net, 100 mx3.mail.ovh.net (dns.google 2026-10-04T14:23:01Z); not verified whether Civam is still on MX Plan rather than another OVH mail product beyond the 2020 guide and the OVH MX; selection: first organization result of a web search for ssl0.ovh.net association setup pages

https://www.uu.se/en/students/it-for-students/email (Uppsala University, last modified 2025-04-22, read 2026-10-04): student mail is hosted in Microsoft 365 Education; the page says mail clients must use Exchange account settings and that POP, IMAP and Outlook.com connection methods are not supported in UU's Office 365 Education; https://www.uu.se/nyheter/2017/2017-01-20-ny-e-posttjanst-till-alla-studenter-i-office-365 (read 2026-10-04): students keep their @student.uu.se addresses; MX 0 student-uu-se.mail.protection.outlook.com (dns.google 2026-10-04T14:27:14Z); selection: next documented organization in the same Nordic-TLD search after Lund (the UU staff settings pages on mp.uu.se did not resolve from here)
